Center the subject in a wide 3:2 visual composition with generous clear margins. Warm editorial medical illustration: elegant organic ink outlines, subtle watercolor shading, muted brick red #92362A, sage green #5D8066, powder blue #4B91B3, ochre #B1854B and charcoal #323331. Professional anatomy-book craft, visually rich but clean. No vector or SVG look, no simplistic geometric placeholder icons, no text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels, logos or watermark. The Chinese captions and exact arrows will be added later outside this image.

Subject: Show a close-up cutaway of ONE working skeletal muscle fiber: a long, gently curved red-pink striated fiber with a visible interior. Several small brick-red glycogen granules sit clearly INSIDE the muscle fiber, near hand-painted mitochondria and contracting myofibrils. The visual meaning is that this muscle uses its own glycogen internally. Keep every glycogen granule inside the fiber; do not show granules entering blood, leaving the fiber, or travelling to the liver. No other organ.
